{{- define "breadcrumbs" -}} {{- $path := .Section.SectionPath -}} {{- $crumbs := .Index.Ancestors $path -}} {{- if or .Page.RelativePath (gt (len $crumbs) 1) }}
    {{- range $i, $s := $crumbs }} {{- if or $.Page.RelativePath (lt (add $i 1) (len $crumbs)) }}
  1. {{ if eq $s.SectionPath "" }}{{ t "docs_home" }}{{ else }}{{ $s.Title }}{{ end }}
    2. {{- end }} {{- end }}
{{- end }} {{- end -}}
